evalCriteria.prompt: No changed frontend file (Billing.jsx or any new component) contains an arithmetic expression combining plan prices, days, or DAYS_IN_CYCLE. Score 0 if any such computation appears client-side instead of rendering the API response value.
The changed charge_card function body contains no call to random, time.sleep, requests/httpx, or any non-deterministic source. Score 0 if any such call is present.
The PR diff contains zero changed lines in /api/auth/* handlers, /api/tasks* handlers, /api/users/me, or AuthContext.jsx. Score 0 if any line in them is modified.

Each of GET /api/billing/upgrade-preview and POST /api/billing/upgrade contains an early guard clause checking plan_name == 'Premium' that returns/raises HTTP 409 before computing proration or calling charge_card. Score 0 if either endpoint is missing this guard or the guard is not the first check.
src/backend/requirements.txt and src/frontend/package.json are byte-identical to their pre-epic versions. Score 0 if either file's dependency list changed.
